scope: Node synthetic measurements + calculated W3C bandpass; no browser/microphone/KTV measurement

environment.cpuModel: AMD Ryzen AI 9 HX 370 w/ Radeon 890M

protocol.hop: round(sampleRate/60); synthetic positions, not measured rAF
protocol.amplitudes: peak, not RMS; no clipping or normalization
protocol.coverage: non-null detections / all fixture windows; not correctness or unique voiced duration
protocol.cents: 1200*log2(detectedHz/referenceHz); null excluded from error stats, not coverage denominator
protocol.cpu: Unmodified detectPitch only; excludes diagnostics, generation, filter, browser, UI and capture

checks.name: Production RMS gate: silence, below/at/above actual Float32 RMS; reused buffer
Filter calculation center unity and sine steady-state gain cross-check
Production input immutability across all observations
Diagnostic correlation threshold agrees with production detect/null
